```{r}
#'  2) 30 x corr(ych4,yco2) = 0.30, 0% masked

#'  4) 30 x corr(ych4,yco2) = 0.30, 50% masked
```

# Custom Functions
```{r}
# Random number generator 
rnormBound <- function(n, mu, sigma){
  Runuran::urnorm(n, mean = mu, sd = sigma, lb = (mu - 3 * sigma), ub = (mu + 3 * sigma))
}
```

```{r}
init_yob <- 2018
final_yob <- 2023


traitNames <- c("bw", "fi", "ch4", "co2", "ych4", "yco2")
traitNames.1d <- c("bw", "fi", "ch4", "co2")
traitNames.2y <- c("bw", "fi", "ych4", "yco2")


# narrow sense heritability
h2_BW <- 0.43
h2_FI <- 0.35
h2_ch4 <- 0.32
h2_co2 <- 0.32
h2_ych4 <- 0.13
h2_yco2 <- 0.13

h2.1d <- c(h2_BW, h2_FI, h2_ch4, h2_co2)
h2.2y <- c(h2_BW, h2_FI, h2_ych4, h2_yco2)





# Correlation of variables
# Phenotype, environmental (dlt), and genetic (dlt) covariance matrices respectively
             #BW
p.cor.1d <- c(0.70, #FI 
              0.52, 0.36, #CH4
              0.45, 0.47, 0.77 #CO2
              )


p.Mean.1d <- c(57.6, 2.39, 17.2, 1248)
p.sd.1d <- c(8.6, 0.43, 3.51, 235)
p.Variance.1d <- p.sd.1d^2

             #BW
p.cor.2y <- c(0.70, #FI 
              0.00, 0.00, #yCH4
              0.00, 0.00, 0.65  #yCO2
              )

p.Mean.2y <- c(57.6, 2.39, 18.6, 1273)
p.sd.2y <- c(8.6, 0.43, 4.92, 250)
p.Variance.2y <- p.sd.2y^2

            #BW
g.cor.1d <- c(0.60, #FI
              0.52, 0.33, #CH4
              0.55, 0.59, 0.62 #CO2
              )

g.Mean.1d <- p.Mean.1d 
g.Variance.1d <- p.Variance.1d * h2.1d

# Correlation matrix
g.rho.1d <- diag(length(traitNames.1d))
g.rho.1d[upper.tri(g.rho.1d)] <- g.cor.1d
low.tri.1d <- lower.tri(g.rho.1d)
g.rho.1d[low.tri.1d] <- t(g.rho.1d)[low.tri.1d]
# Make correlation matrix positive definite.
g.rho.1d <- corpcor::make.positive.definite(g.rho.1d)
# Covariance matrix of correlated traits.
g.sigma.1d <- sqrt(g.Variance.1d %*% t(g.Variance.1d)) * g.rho.1d
g.sigma.1d <- corpcor::make.positive.definite(g.sigma.1d)
g.cov_matrix.1d <- as.matrix(g.sigma.1d)

              #BW
g.cor.2y <- c(0.60, #FI
              0.00, 0.00, #yCH4
              0.00, 0.00, 0.00  #yCO2
              )

g.Mean.2y <- p.Mean.2y 
g.Variance.2y <- p.Variance.2y * h2.2y

# Correlation matrix
g.rho.2y <- diag(length(traitNames.2y))
g.rho.2y[upper.tri(g.rho.2y)] <- g.cor.2y
low.tri.2y <- lower.tri(g.rho.2y)
g.rho.2y[low.tri.2y] <- t(g.rho.2y)[low.tri.2y]
# Make correlation matrix positive definite.
g.rho.2y <- corpcor::make.positive.definite(g.rho.2y)
# Covariance matrix of correlated traits.
g.sigma.2y <- sqrt(g.Variance.2y %*% t(g.Variance.2y)) * g.rho.2y
g.sigma.2y <- corpcor::make.positive.definite(g.sigma.2y)
g.cov_matrix.2y <- as.matrix(g.sigma.2y)






# the e.cor correlation matrix is calculated using h2, g.cor, and p.cor
e.cor.1d <- numeric(length(p.cor.1d)) 
idx <- 1
for (i in 2:length(traitNames.1d)) {
  for (j in 1:(i - 1)) {
    h_i.1d <- (h2.1d[i])
    h_j.1d <- (h2.1d[j])
    
    # e.cor equation (working in notebook and Peter's email)
    denom.1d <- sqrt((1 - h2.1d[i])) * sqrt((1 - h2.1d[j]))
    e.cor.1d[idx] <- (p.cor.1d[idx] - sqrt(h_i.1d) * sqrt(h_j.1d) * g.cor.1d[idx]) / denom.1d
    idx <- idx + 1
  }
}


e.Mean.1d <- c(0, 0, 0, 0)
e.sd.1d <- sqrt(p.Variance.1d * (1 - h2.1d))
e.Variance.1d <- e.sd.1d^2

# Correlation matrix
e.rho.1d <- diag(length(traitNames.1d))
e.rho.1d[upper.tri(e.rho.1d)] <- e.cor.1d
low.tri <- lower.tri(e.rho.1d)
e.rho.1d[low.tri.1d] <- t(e.rho.1d)[low.tri.1d]
# Make correlation matrix positive definite.
e.rho.1d <- corpcor::make.positive.definite(e.rho.1d)
# Covariance matrix of correlated traits.
e.sigma.1d <- sqrt(e.Variance.1d %*% t(e.Variance.1d)) * e.rho.1d
e.sigma.1d <- corpcor::make.positive.definite(e.sigma.1d)
e.cov_matrix.1d <- as.matrix(e.sigma.1d)


# the e.cor correlation matrix is calculated using h2, g.cor, and p.cor
e.cor.2y <- numeric(length(p.cor.2y)) 
idx <- 1
for (i in 2:length(traitNames.2y)) {
  for (j in 1:(i - 1)) {
    h_i.2y <- (h2.2y[i])
    h_j.2y <- (h2.2y[j])
    
    # e.cor equation (working in notebook and Peter's email)
    denom.2y <- sqrt((1 - h2.2y[i])) * sqrt((1 - h2.2y[j]))
    e.cor.2y[idx] <- (p.cor.2y[idx] - sqrt(h_i.2y) * sqrt(h_j.2y) * g.cor.2y[idx]) / denom.2y
    idx <- idx + 1
  }
}


e.Mean.2y <- c(0, 0, 0, 0)
e.sd.2y <- sqrt(p.Variance.2y * (1 - h2.2y))
e.Variance.2y <- e.sd.2y^2

# Correlation matrix
e.rho.2y <- diag(length(traitNames.2y))
e.rho.2y[upper.tri(e.rho.2y)] <- e.cor.2y
low.tri <- lower.tri(e.rho.2y)
e.rho.2y[low.tri.2y] <- t(e.rho.2y)[low.tri.2y]
# Make correlation matrix positive definite.
e.rho.2y <- corpcor::make.positive.definite(e.rho.2y)
# Covariance matrix of correlated traits.
e.sigma.2y <- sqrt(e.Variance.2y %*% t(e.Variance.2y)) * e.rho.2y
e.sigma.2y <- corpcor::make.positive.definite(e.sigma.2y)
e.cov_matrix.2y <- as.matrix(e.sigma.2y)
```

```{r}
# For mating
surv_rate_f <- 0.8
surv_rate_m <- 0.7

select_sires_num <- 60

# Settings that reproduce the published datasets ("as_run").
# inbreeding_rule:
#   "as_run"   = only rams with known parents were prevented from mating their own
#                daughters; half-sib matings were not restricted
#   "intended" = rams cannot mate their own daughters or half-sib ewes
#                (founder rams exempt from the half-sib rule only)
# gas_fe_rule:
#   "as_run"   = fixed effects (sex, year of birth, dam parity, litter size) were applied to
#                methane yield, CO2 yield, daily CH4 and daily CO2 for founders only;
#                animals born 2018-2023 have no fixed effects on these traits
#   "intended" = the fixed effects are applied to all animals
inbreeding_rule <- "as_run"
gas_fe_rule     <- "as_run"

n_gen <- final_yob - init_yob + 1        # number of generations to simulate assuming 1 lambing per year
```



```{r}
set.seed(5)

gen_found_pop <- function(
    ff1_fnum,
    ff1_mnum,
    finit_yob,
    ffinal_yob,
    ff1_dobMean_f,
    ff1_dobMean_m,
    ff1_dobSD,
    forigin_dob,
    fdp_1,
    fdp_2,
    fdp_3,
    fls_1,
    fls_2,
    fls_3,
    fbw_sex_eft_f, 
    fbw_sex_eft_m,
    fbw_dp_eft_1, 
    fbw_dp_eft_2,
    fbw_ls_eft_1,
    fbw_ls_eft_2,
    fbw_ls_eft_3,
    fbw_ls_eft_4,
    fFI_sex_eft_f, 
    fFI_sex_eft_m,
    fFI_dp_eft_1, 
    fFI_dp_eft_2,
    fFI_ls_eft_1,
    fFI_ls_eft_2,
    fFI_ls_eft_3,
    fFI_ls_eft_4,
    fch4_sex_eft_f, 
    fch4_sex_eft_m,
    fch4_dp_eft_1, 
    fch4_dp_eft_2,
    fch4_ls_eft_1,
    fch4_ls_eft_2,
    fch4_ls_eft_3,
    fch4_ls_eft_4,
    fco2_sex_eft_f, 
    fco2_sex_eft_m,
    fco2_dp_eft_1, 
    fco2_dp_eft_2,
    fco2_ls_eft_1,
    fco2_ls_eft_2,
    fco2_ls_eft_3,
    fco2_ls_eft_4,
    fych4_sex_eft_f, 
    fych4_sex_eft_m,
    fych4_dp_eft_1, 
    fych4_dp_eft_2,
    fych4_ls_eft_1,
    fych4_ls_eft_2,
    fych4_ls_eft_3,
    fych4_ls_eft_4,
    fyco2_sex_eft_f, 
    fyco2_sex_eft_m,
    fyco2_dp_eft_1, 
    fyco2_dp_eft_2,
    fyco2_ls_eft_1,
    fyco2_ls_eft_2,
    fyco2_ls_eft_3,
    fyco2_ls_eft_4,
    fg.Mean.1d, 
    fg.cov_matrix.1d,
    fg.Mean.2y, 
    fg.cov_matrix.2y,
    fe.Mean.1d, 
    fe.cov_matrix.1d,
    fe.Mean.2y, 
    fe.cov_matrix.2y,
    frnormBound) {
  
  
  # total number of founders 
  f1_totnum <- ff1_fnum + ff1_mnum
  
  
  # pedigree
  ped2 <- data.table(
    id = 1:f1_totnum,
    sire = rep(0, f1_totnum),
    dam = rep(0, f1_totnum),
    sex = c(rep("F", ff1_fnum), rep("M", ff1_mnum))
  )
  
  
  # founder date of birth generator
  f1_dob_f <- as.Date(frnormBound(ff1_fnum, ff1_dobMean_f, ff1_dobSD), origin = as.Date(forigin_dob))
  f1_dob_m <- as.Date(frnormBound(ff1_mnum, ff1_dobMean_m, ff1_dobSD), origin = as.Date(forigin_dob))
  f1_dob <- c(f1_dob_f, f1_dob_m)
  f1_julian_dob <- as.numeric(round(as.Date(f1_dob) - as.Date(forigin_dob), 0))
  f1_dates <- data.table(dob = f1_dob, julian_dob = f1_julian_dob)
  f1_dates[, yob := format(dob, "%Y")]
  
  
  # founder dam parity
  f1_dp <- data.table(dp_rand = runif(f1_totnum))
  f1_dp[, dam_parity := fcase(
    dp_rand < fdp_1, 1,
    dp_rand >= fdp_1 & dp_rand < fdp_2, 2,
    dp_rand >= fdp_2 & dp_rand < fdp_3, 3,
    dp_rand >= fdp_3, 4
    )][, dp_rand := NULL]
  
  
  # founder litter size
  f1_ls <- data.table(ls_rand = runif(f1_totnum))
  f1_ls[, litter_size := fcase(
    ls_rand < fls_1, 1,
    ls_rand >= fls_1 & ls_rand < fls_2, 2,
    ls_rand >= fls_2 & ls_rand < fls_3, 3,
    ls_rand >= fls_3, 4
    )][, ls_rand := NULL]
  

  # survival rate for first year of founder mating (2018 all alive = 1)
  # Create the survival data.table
  surv_year_cols <- paste0("surv_", finit_yob:ffinal_yob)
  surv_year_dt <- data.table(matrix(NA_integer_, nrow = f1_totnum, ncol = length(surv_year_cols)))
  setnames(surv_year_dt, surv_year_cols)
  
  # First year: all alive
  first_col <- paste0("surv_", finit_yob)
  surv_year_dt[[first_col]] <- 1L
  
  # Loop through each year
  for (y in (finit_yob + 1):ffinal_yob) {
    curr_col <- paste0("surv_", y)
    prev_col <- paste0("surv_", y - 1)
    
    surv_year_dt[[curr_col]] <- 0L
    
    # Those alive in previous year
    survivors_prev <- surv_year_dt[[prev_col]] == 1
    
    # Subset indices for males and females who survived
    female_ids <- which(survivors_prev & ped2$sex == "F")
    male_ids   <- which(survivors_prev & ped2$sex == "M")
    
    # Apply survival for females (constant 0.8)
    surv_year_dt[female_ids, (curr_col) := as.integer(runif(length(female_ids)) < surv_rate_f)]
    
    # Count how many years each male has already survived
    if (length(male_ids) > 0) {
      male_survived_years <- rowSums(surv_year_dt[male_ids, ..surv_year_cols, with = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)
      
      # Males alive <3 years: survival with prob 0.7
      still_young <- male_ids[male_survived_years < 3]
      surv_year_dt[still_young, (curr_col) := as.integer(runif(length(still_young)) < surv_rate_m)]
      
      # Males alive ≥3 years: die
      too_old <- male_ids[male_survived_years >= 3]
      surv_year_dt[too_old, (curr_col) := 0L]
    }
  }

  
  
  # combine pedigree & fixed effects & survival data
  f1_full <- cbind(ped2, f1_dates, f1_dp, f1_ls, surv_year_dt)
  
  
  # fixed effects
  
    # random sampling of bw
  bw_yob_eft_2015 <- rnorm(1, 0, 2.5)
  bw_yob_eft_2017 <- rnorm(1, 0, 2.5)
  # fixed effect body weight
  f1_full[, bw_sex_eft := ifelse(
    sex == "F", fbw_sex_eft_f, fbw_sex_eft_m
  )]
  f1_full[, bw_yob_eft := fcase(
    yob == 2016, bw_yob_eft_2015,
    yob == 2017, bw_yob_eft_2017
  )]
  f1_full[, bw_dp_eft := fcase(
    dam_parity == 1, fbw_dp_eft_1,
    dam_parity > 1, fbw_dp_eft_2
  )]
  f1_full[, bw_ls_eft := fcase(
    litter_size == 1, fbw_ls_eft_1,
    litter_size == 2, fbw_ls_eft_2,
    litter_size == 3, fbw_ls_eft_3,
    litter_size == 4, fbw_ls_eft_4
  )]
  
  
    # random sampling of FI
  FI_yob_eft_2015 <- rnorm(1, 0, 0.12)
  FI_yob_eft_2017 <- rnorm(1, 0, 0.12)
  # fixed effect feed intake
  f1_full[, fi_sex_eft := ifelse(
    sex == "F", fFI_sex_eft_f, fFI_sex_eft_m
  )]
  f1_full[, fi_yob_eft := fcase(
    yob == 2016, FI_yob_eft_2015,
    yob == 2017, FI_yob_eft_2017
  )]
  f1_full[, fi_dp_eft := fcase(
    dam_parity == 1, fFI_dp_eft_1,
    dam_parity > 1, fFI_dp_eft_2
  )]
  f1_full[, fi_ls_eft := fcase(
    litter_size == 1, fFI_ls_eft_1,
    litter_size == 2, fFI_ls_eft_2,
    litter_size == 3, fFI_ls_eft_3,
    litter_size == 4, fFI_ls_eft_4
  )]
  
  
      # random sampling of ch4
  ch4_yob_eft_2015 <- rnorm(1, 0, 1.8)
  ch4_yob_eft_2017 <- rnorm(1, 0, 1.8)
  # Fixed effect methane
  f1_full[, ch4_sex_eft := ifelse(
    sex == "F", fch4_sex_eft_f, fch4_sex_eft_m
  )]
  f1_full[, ch4_yob_eft := fcase(
    yob == 2016, ch4_yob_eft_2015,
    yob == 2017, ch4_yob_eft_2017
  )]
  f1_full[, ch4_dp_eft := fcase(
    dam_parity == 1, fch4_dp_eft_1,
    dam_parity > 1, fch4_dp_eft_2
  )]
  f1_full[, ch4_ls_eft := fcase(
    litter_size == 1, fch4_ls_eft_1,
    litter_size == 2, fch4_ls_eft_2,
    litter_size == 3, fch4_ls_eft_3,
    litter_size == 4, fch4_ls_eft_4
  )]
  
  
      # random sampling of co2
  co2_yob_eft_2015 <- rnorm(1, 0, 90)
  co2_yob_eft_2017 <- rnorm(1, 0, 90) 
   # Fixed effect carbon dioxide
  f1_full[, co2_sex_eft := ifelse(
    sex == "F", fco2_sex_eft_f, fco2_sex_eft_m
  )]
  f1_full[, co2_yob_eft := fcase(
    yob == 2016, co2_yob_eft_2015,
    yob == 2017, co2_yob_eft_2017
  )]
  f1_full[, co2_dp_eft := fcase(
    dam_parity == 1, fco2_dp_eft_1,
    dam_parity > 1, fco2_dp_eft_2
  )]
  f1_full[, co2_ls_eft := fcase(
    litter_size == 1, fco2_ls_eft_1,
    litter_size == 2, fco2_ls_eft_2,
    litter_size == 3, fco2_ls_eft_3,
    litter_size == 4, fco2_ls_eft_4
  )]
  
  
      # random sampling of ych4
  ych4_yob_eft_2015 <- rnorm(1, 0, 1.6)
  ych4_yob_eft_2017 <- rnorm(1, 0, 1.6) 
  # Fixed effect yield methane
  f1_full[, ych4_sex_eft := ifelse(
    sex == "F", fych4_sex_eft_f, fych4_sex_eft_m
  )]
  f1_full[, ych4_yob_eft := fcase(
    yob == 2016, ych4_yob_eft_2015,
    yob == 2017, ych4_yob_eft_2017
  )]
  f1_full[, ych4_dp_eft := fcase(
    dam_parity == 1, fych4_dp_eft_1,
    dam_parity > 1, fych4_dp_eft_2
  )]
  f1_full[, ych4_ls_eft := fcase(
    litter_size == 1, fych4_ls_eft_1,
    litter_size == 2, fych4_ls_eft_2,
    litter_size == 3, fych4_ls_eft_3,
    litter_size == 4, fych4_ls_eft_4
  )]  
  
  
      # random sampling of yco2
  yco2_yob_eft_2015 <- rnorm(1, 0, 70)
  yco2_yob_eft_2017 <- rnorm(1, 0, 70) 
  # Fixed effect yield carbon dioxide
  f1_full[, yco2_sex_eft := ifelse(
    sex == "F", fyco2_sex_eft_f, fyco2_sex_eft_m
  )]
  f1_full[, yco2_yob_eft := fcase(
    yob == 2016, yco2_yob_eft_2015,
    yob == 2017, yco2_yob_eft_2017
  )]
  f1_full[, yco2_dp_eft := fcase(
    dam_parity == 1, fyco2_dp_eft_1,
    dam_parity > 1, fyco2_dp_eft_2
  )]
    f1_full[, yco2_ls_eft := fcase(
    litter_size == 1, fyco2_ls_eft_1,
    litter_size == 2, fyco2_ls_eft_2,
    litter_size == 3, fyco2_ls_eft_3,
    litter_size == 4, fyco2_ls_eft_4
  )]
  
  # ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~ #
    
  ## ======= 2y-driven conditional draws for TBVs and ENV =======
  
  # indices
  c_idx     <- c(1, 2)  # bw, fi
  r_idx_2y  <- c(3, 4)  # ych4, yco2  (in 2y)
  r_idx_1d  <- c(3, 4)  # ch4,  co2   (in 1d)
  
  ## ---------- TBVs ----------
  # Blocks: genetics
  g_mu_c_2y    <- fg.Mean.2y[c_idx]
  g_Scc_2y     <- fg.cov_matrix.2y[c_idx, c_idx, drop = FALSE]
  g_Src_2y     <- fg.cov_matrix.2y[r_idx_2y, c_idx, drop = FALSE]
  g_Srr_2y     <- fg.cov_matrix.2y[r_idx_2y, r_idx_2y, drop = FALSE]
  
  g_mu_c_1d    <- fg.Mean.1d[c_idx]
  g_Scc_1d     <- fg.cov_matrix.1d[c_idx, c_idx, drop = FALSE]
  g_Src_1d     <- fg.cov_matrix.1d[r_idx_1d, c_idx, drop = FALSE]
  g_Srr_1d     <- fg.cov_matrix.1d[r_idx_1d, r_idx_1d, drop = FALSE]
  
  # 1) common (bw,fi) from 2y genetics
  Cg <- MASS::mvrnorm(n = f1_totnum, mu = g_mu_c_2y, Sigma = g_Scc_2y)  # n x 2
  
  # helpers
  g_Scc_inv_2y <- solve(g_Scc_2y)
  g_Scc_inv_1d <- solve(g_Scc_1d)
  
  dev_g_2y <- sweep(Cg, 2, g_mu_c_2y, "-")   # n x 2
  dev_g_1d <- sweep(Cg, 2, g_mu_c_1d, "-")   # n x 2
  
  # 2) 2y remainder (ych4,yco2) | (bw,fi)
  g_cond_mean_2y <- t(g_Src_2y %*% g_Scc_inv_2y %*% t(dev_g_2y)) +
                    matrix(rep(fg.Mean.2y[r_idx_2y], each = f1_totnum), ncol = 2, byrow = FALSE)
  g_cond_cov_2y  <- g_Srr_2y - g_Src_2y %*% g_Scc_inv_2y %*% t(g_Src_2y)
  Rg_2y          <- g_cond_mean_2y + MASS::mvrnorm(n = f1_totnum, mu = c(0,0), Sigma = g_cond_cov_2y)
  
  # 3) 1d remainder (ch4,co2) | (bw,fi)
  g_cond_mean_1d <- t(g_Src_1d %*% g_Scc_inv_1d %*% t(dev_g_1d)) +
                    matrix(rep(fg.Mean.1d[r_idx_1d], each = f1_totnum), ncol = 2, byrow = FALSE)
  g_cond_cov_1d  <- g_Srr_1d - g_Src_1d %*% g_Scc_inv_1d %*% t(g_Src_1d)
  Rg_1d          <- g_cond_mean_1d + MASS::mvrnorm(n = f1_totnum, mu = c(0,0), Sigma = g_cond_cov_1d)
  
  # assemble TBVs
  f1_tbv <- data.table::data.table(
    bw.tbv   = Cg[, 1],
    fi.tbv   = Cg[, 2],
    ch4.tbv  = Rg_1d[, 1],
    co2.tbv  = Rg_1d[, 2],
    ych4.tbv = Rg_2y[, 1],
    yco2.tbv = Rg_2y[, 2]
  )
  
  ## ---------- ENV ----------
  # Blocks: environment
  e_mu_c_2y    <- fe.Mean.2y[c_idx]
  e_Scc_2y     <- fe.cov_matrix.2y[c_idx, c_idx, drop = FALSE]
  e_Src_2y     <- fe.cov_matrix.2y[r_idx_2y, c_idx, drop = FALSE]
  e_Srr_2y     <- fe.cov_matrix.2y[r_idx_2y, r_idx_2y, drop = FALSE]
  
  e_mu_c_1d    <- fe.Mean.1d[c_idx]
  e_Scc_1d     <- fe.cov_matrix.1d[c_idx, c_idx, drop = FALSE]
  e_Src_1d     <- fe.cov_matrix.1d[r_idx_1d, c_idx, drop = FALSE]
  e_Srr_1d     <- fe.cov_matrix.1d[r_idx_1d, r_idx_1d, drop = FALSE]
  
  # 1) common (bw,fi) from 2y environment
  Ce <- MASS::mvrnorm(n = f1_totnum, mu = e_mu_c_2y, Sigma = e_Scc_2y)
  
  # helpers
  e_Scc_inv_2y <- solve(e_Scc_2y)
  e_Scc_inv_1d <- solve(e_Scc_1d)
  
  dev_e_2y <- sweep(Ce, 2, e_mu_c_2y, "-")
  dev_e_1d <- sweep(Ce, 2, e_mu_c_1d, "-")
  
  # 2) 2y remainder (ych4,yco2) | (bw,fi)
  e_cond_mean_2y <- t(e_Src_2y %*% e_Scc_inv_2y %*% t(dev_e_2y)) +
                    matrix(rep(fe.Mean.2y[r_idx_2y], each = f1_totnum), ncol = 2, byrow = FALSE)
  e_cond_cov_2y  <- e_Srr_2y - e_Src_2y %*% e_Scc_inv_2y %*% t(e_Src_2y)
  Re_2y          <- e_cond_mean_2y + MASS::mvrnorm(n = f1_totnum, mu = c(0,0), Sigma = e_cond_cov_2y)
  
  # 3) 1d remainder (ch4,co2) | (bw,fi)
  e_cond_mean_1d <- t(e_Src_1d %*% e_Scc_inv_1d %*% t(dev_e_1d)) +
                    matrix(rep(fe.Mean.1d[r_idx_1d], each = f1_totnum), ncol = 2, byrow = FALSE)
  e_cond_cov_1d  <- e_Srr_1d - e_Src_1d %*% e_Scc_inv_1d %*% t(e_Src_1d)
  Re_1d          <- e_cond_mean_1d + MASS::mvrnorm(n = f1_totnum, mu = c(0,0), Sigma = e_cond_cov_1d)
  
  # assemble ENV
  f1_env <- data.table::data.table(
    bw.env   = Ce[, 1],
    fi.env   = Ce[, 2],
    ch4.env  = Re_1d[, 1],
    co2.env  = Re_1d[, 2],
    ych4.env = Re_2y[, 1],
    yco2.env = Re_2y[, 2]
  )

  # ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~ #
  
  f1_full_tbvs_env <- cbind(f1_full, f1_tbv, f1_env)
  
  f1_full_tbvs_env[, bw.p := rowSums(.SD, na.rm = TRUE), .SDcols = patterns("^bw")]
  f1_full_tbvs_env[, fi.p := pmax(0.05, rowSums(.SD, na.rm = TRUE)), .SDcols = patterns("^fi")]
  f1_full_tbvs_env[, ch4.p := rowSums(.SD, na.rm = TRUE), .SDcols = patterns("^ch4")]
  f1_full_tbvs_env[, co2.p := rowSums(.SD, na.rm = TRUE), .SDcols = patterns("^co2")]
  f1_full_tbvs_env[, ych4.p := pmax(5, rowSums(.SD, na.rm = TRUE)), .SDcols = patterns("^ych4")]
  f1_full_tbvs_env[, yco2.p := rowSums(.SD, na.rm = TRUE), .SDcols = patterns("^yco2")]
  
  fcond <- f1_full_tbvs_env
  
  fcond[, grep("eft$", names(f1_full_tbvs_env), value = TRUE) := NULL]
  fcond[, grep("env$", names(f1_full_tbvs_env), value = TRUE) := NULL]
  fcond[, ch4.p.x := ych4.p * fi.p]
  fcond[, co2.p.x := yco2.p * fi.p]
  
  return(list(
    expanded = cbind(f1_full, f1_full_tbvs_env[, !names(f1_full_tbvs_env) %in% names(f1_full), with = FALSE]),
    condensed = fcond
  ))
}
```

Working for mating function 

We will use 

If we were to have 6 years of reproduction and have 1500 offspring born each season with a survival rate of 0.8, we will have 9520 animals created in the simulation and 7616 animals surviving by the end of the simulation.




Mating function
```{r}


mate_founders <- function(
    ffounder,
    fselect_sires_num,
    fn_gen,
    finit_yob,
    ffinal_yob,
    fdp_1,
    fdp_2,
    fdp_3,
    fls_1,
    fls_2,
    fls_3,
    fbw_sex_eft_f, 
    fbw_sex_eft_m,
    fbw_dp_eft_1, 
    fbw_dp_eft_2,
    fbw_ls_eft_1,
    fbw_ls_eft_2,
    fbw_ls_eft_3,
    fbw_ls_eft_4,
    fFI_sex_eft_f, 
    fFI_sex_eft_m,
    fFI_dp_eft_1, 
    fFI_dp_eft_2,
    fFI_ls_eft_1,
    fFI_ls_eft_2,
    fFI_ls_eft_3,
    fFI_ls_eft_4,
    fch4_sex_eft_f, 
    fch4_sex_eft_m,
    fch4_dp_eft_1, 
    fch4_dp_eft_2,
    fch4_ls_eft_1,
    fch4_ls_eft_2,
    fch4_ls_eft_3,
    fch4_ls_eft_4,
    fco2_sex_eft_f, 
    fco2_sex_eft_m,
    fco2_dp_eft_1, 
    fco2_dp_eft_2,
    fco2_ls_eft_1,
    fco2_ls_eft_2,
    fco2_ls_eft_3,
    fco2_ls_eft_4,
    fych4_sex_eft_f, 
    fych4_sex_eft_m,
    fych4_dp_eft_1, 
    fych4_dp_eft_2,
    fych4_ls_eft_1,
    fych4_ls_eft_2,
    fych4_ls_eft_3,
    fych4_ls_eft_4,
    fyco2_sex_eft_f, 
    fyco2_sex_eft_m,
    fyco2_dp_eft_1, 
    fyco2_dp_eft_2,
    fyco2_ls_eft_1,
    fyco2_ls_eft_2,
    fyco2_ls_eft_3,
    fyco2_ls_eft_4,
    fg.sigma.1d, 
    fg.sigma.2y,
    fe.Mean.1d, 
    fe.cov_matrix.1d,
    fe.Mean.2y, 
    fe.cov_matrix.2y,
    rnormBound,
    inbreeding_rule = "as_run",
    gas_fe_rule     = "as_run"
) {
  prev_gen <- ffounder
  new_gen <- ffounder
  
  for (g in 1:fn_gen){
    ## New section giving each alive dam a child
    latest_yob <- as.numeric(max(prev_gen$yob)) + 1 # a year after prev gen
    first_yob <- as.numeric(min(prev_gen$yob)) + 2  # 2018 because this is not counting founder dobs
    all_years <- first_yob:(latest_yob + 1) 
    
    surv_year <- max(finit_yob, latest_yob)
    
    # most recent year with survival (which has to be the year before the current year hence "-1")
    
    latest_surv_col <- grep(paste0("surv_", surv_year), names(prev_gen), value = TRUE)
    # latest_surv_col <- latest_surv_col[which.max(as.integer(sub("surv_", "", latest_surv_col)))]

    ####
    # Determine if we are generating offspring for the first_yob
    if (latest_surv_col == paste0("surv_", finit_yob)) {
      
      # No survival columns exist yet — use all eligible founders
      eligible_dams <- prev_gen[
        sex == "F" & yob < first_yob,
        .(id, sire, dam, yob)
      ]
      
      selected_sires <- prev_gen[
        sex == "M" & yob < first_yob,
        .(id, sire, dam)
      ]
      
    } else {
      
      # Dams alive in the previous year
      eligible_dams <- prev_gen[
        sex == "F" & yob <= (latest_yob - 2) & get(latest_surv_col) == 1,
        .(id, sire, dam, yob)
      ]
      
      # Sires alive in the previous year
      selected_sires <- prev_gen[
        sex == "M" & get(latest_surv_col) == 1,
        .(id, sire, dam)
      ]
    }

    # Rename ancestry columns
    setnames(eligible_dams, c("id", "sire", "dam", "yob"), c("id", "dam_sire", "dam_dam", "dam_yob"))
    setnames(selected_sires, c("id", "sire", "dam"), c("id", "sire_sire", "sire_dam"))
    ####
    
    offsp_num <- nrow(eligible_dams) # we want every eligible dam to have a litter
    
    new_ped <- data.table(
      id       = (max(new_gen$id) + 1):(max(new_gen$id) + offsp_num),
      dam      = eligible_dams$id,
      dam_sire = eligible_dams$dam_sire,
      dam_dam  = eligible_dams$dam_dam
    )   
    
    # randomly select sires in accordance with inbreeding prevention rules
    new_ped[, sire := NA_integer_]
    
    
    for (i in 1:offsp_num) {
      dam_id     <- new_ped$dam[i]
      dam_sire   <- new_ped$dam_sire[i]
      dam_dam    <- new_ped$dam_dam[i]
      
      # Filter sires that don’t share ancestry with the dam or are founders
      
      ####
      # Filter eligible dams
      if (inbreeding_rule == "as_run") {
        # as run for the published datasets
        possible_sires <- selected_sires[
          (sire_sire == 0 & sire_dam == 0) |   # founder rams: no restriction
          id != dam_sire                        # other rams: not her own sire
        ]
      } else {
        # intended rule: not her sire, and not a half-sib (founder rams exempt from half-sib rule)
        possible_sires <- selected_sires[
          id != dam_sire &
            (
              (sire_sire == 0 & sire_dam == 0) |
              (
                sire_sire != dam_sire &
                sire_dam  != dam_dam
              )
            )
        ]
      }
      
      if (nrow(possible_sires) > 0) {
        new_ped$sire[i] <- sample(possible_sires$id, 1)
      } else {
        warning("No eligible sires found")
      }
    }
      ####
      
      

    
    new_ped[, c("dam_sire", "dam_dam") := NULL]
    setcolorder(new_ped, c("id", "sire", "dam"))
    
    
    # fixed effect traits traits
    new_fet <- data.table(sex = sample(c("M", "F"), offsp_num, replace = TRUE))
    
    # dob
    gn_dob <- as.Date(rnormBound(offsp_num, (288 + (latest_yob-finit_yob + 3) * 365), 
                                 f1_dobSD), origin = as.Date(origin_dob))
    gn_julian_dob <- as.numeric(round(as.Date(gn_dob) - as.Date(origin_dob), 0))
    gn_dates <- data.table(dob = gn_dob, julian_dob = gn_julian_dob)
    new_fet <- cbind(new_fet, gn_dates)
    new_fet[, yob := format(dob, "%Y")]
    
    # dam parity
    gn_dp_prior <- data.table(id = new_ped$id,
                        dp_dam = new_ped$dam,
                        dp_yob = new_fet$yob
                        )
    gn_dp <- merge(
      gn_dp_prior,
      eligible_dams,
      by.x = "dp_dam",
      by.y = "id",
      all.x = TRUE  # keep all rows from gn_dp_prior
      )
    gn_dp[, dp_yob := as.numeric(dp_yob)]
    gn_dp[, dam_yob := as.numeric(dam_yob)]
    gn_dp[, dam_parity := dp_yob - (dam_yob + 2) + 1] # +1 accounts for current birth being counted
    gn_dp <- gn_dp[, .(dam_parity)]
    new_fet <- cbind(new_fet, gn_dp)
    
    # litter size
    gn_ls <- data.table(ls_rand = runif(offsp_num))
    gn_ls[, litter_size := fcase(
      ls_rand < fls_1, 1,
      ls_rand >= fls_1 & ls_rand < fls_2, 2,
      ls_rand >= fls_2 & ls_rand < fls_3, 3,
      ls_rand >= fls_3, 4
    )][, ls_rand := NULL]
    new_fet <- cbind(new_fet, gn_ls)
    
    # survival rate for first year of founder mating (2018 all alive = 1)
    years <- finit_yob:ffinal_yob

    surv_year_cols <- paste0("surv_", finit_yob:ffinal_yob)
    surv_year_dt <- data.table(matrix(NA_integer_, nrow = offsp_num, ncol = length(surv_year_cols)))
    setnames(surv_year_dt, surv_year_cols)
    
    
    for (y in finit_yob:ffinal_yob) {
      col <- paste0("surv_", y)
    
      if (y < latest_yob) {
        surv_year_dt[[col]] <- 0L  # Not yet born
      } 
      else if (y == latest_yob) {
        surv_year_dt[[col]] <- 1L  # All born alive
      } 
      else {
        prev_col <- paste0("surv_", y - 1)
        alive_last_year <- surv_year_dt[[prev_col]] == 1L
    
        surv_year_dt[[col]] <- 0L  # default to dead
    
        # Get survivors by sex
        female_ids <- which(alive_last_year & new_fet$sex == "F")
        male_ids   <- which(alive_last_year & new_fet$sex == "M")
    
        # Females: survive with surv_rate_f
        if (length(female_ids) > 0) {
          surv_year_dt[female_ids, (col) := as.integer(runif(length(female_ids)) < surv_rate_f)]
        }
    
        # Males: check survival duration before applying rate
        if (length(male_ids) > 0) {
          # Count how many years each male has survived so far
          male_survived_years <- rowSums(
            surv_year_dt[male_ids, ..surv_year_cols, with = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE
          )
    
          # Males with <3 years of survival
          still_young <- male_ids[male_survived_years < 3]
          if (length(still_young) > 0) {
            surv_year_dt[still_young, (col) := as.integer(runif(length(still_young)) < surv_rate_m)]
          }
    
          # Males with ≥3 years of survival: die
          too_old <- male_ids[male_survived_years >= 3]
          if (length(too_old) > 0) {
            surv_year_dt[too_old, (col) := 0L]
          }
        }
      }
    }
    
    new_fet <- cbind(new_fet, surv_year_dt)
    
    # fixed effects
    bw_yob_eft_2018 <- rnorm(1, 0, 2.5)
    bw_yob_eft_2019 <- rnorm(1, 0, 2.5)
    bw_yob_eft_2020 <- rnorm(1, 0, 2.5)
    bw_yob_eft_2021 <- rnorm(1, 0, 2.5)
    bw_yob_eft_2022 <- rnorm(1, 0, 2.5)
    bw_yob_eft_2023 <- rnorm(1, 0, 2.5)
    # fixed effect body weight
    new_fet[, bw_sex_eft := ifelse(
      sex == "F", fbw_sex_eft_f, fbw_sex_eft_m
    )]
    new_fet[, bw_yob_eft := fcase(
      yob == 2018, bw_yob_eft_2018,
      yob == 2019, bw_yob_eft_2019,
      yob == 2020, bw_yob_eft_2020,
      yob == 2021, bw_yob_eft_2021,
      yob == 2022, bw_yob_eft_2022,
      yob == 2023, bw_yob_eft_2023
    )]
    new_fet[, bw_dp_eft := fcase(
      dam_parity == 1, fbw_dp_eft_1,
      dam_parity > 1, fbw_dp_eft_2
    )]
    new_fet[, bw_ls_eft := fcase(
      litter_size == 1, fbw_ls_eft_1,
      litter_size == 2, fbw_ls_eft_2,
      litter_size == 3, fbw_ls_eft_3,
      litter_size == 4, fbw_ls_eft_4
    )]
    
    

    # fixed effect feed intake
    FI_yob_eft_2018 <- rnorm(1, 0, 0.12)
    FI_yob_eft_2019 <- rnorm(1, 0, 0.12)
    FI_yob_eft_2020 <- rnorm(1, 0, 0.12)
    FI_yob_eft_2021 <- rnorm(1, 0, 0.12)

    new_fet[, fi_sex_eft := ifelse(

    # Fixed effect methane
    ch4_yob_eft_2018 <- rnorm(1, 0, 1.8)

    ch4_yob_eft_2020 <- rnorm(1, 0, 1.8)
    ch4_yob_eft_2021 <- rnorm(1, 0, 1.8)
    ch4_yob_eft_2022 <- rnorm(1, 0, 1.8)
    ch4_yob_eft_2023 <- rnorm(1, 0, 1.8)
    new_fet[, ch4_sex_eft := ifelse(

    new_fet[, ch4_yob_eft := fcase(

    )]
    new_fet[, ch4_dp_eft := fcase(

    )]
    new_fet[, ch4_ls_eft := fcase(

    )]
    
    
    # Fixed effect carbon dioxide
    co2_yob_eft_2018 <- rnorm(1, 0, 90)
    co2_yob_eft_2019 <- rnorm(1, 0, 90)
    co2_yob_eft_2020 <- rnorm(1, 0, 90)
    co2_yob_eft_2021 <- rnorm(1, 0, 90)
    co2_yob_eft_2022 <- rnorm(1, 0, 90)
    co2_yob_eft_2023 <- rnorm(1, 0, 90)
    new_fet[, co2_sex_eft := ifelse(
      sex == "F", fco2_sex_eft_f, fco2_sex_eft_m
    )]
    new_fet[, co2_yob_eft := fcase(
      yob == 2018, co2_yob_eft_2018,
      yob == 2019, co2_yob_eft_2019,
      yob == 2020, co2_yob_eft_2020,
      yob == 2021, co2_yob_eft_2021,
      yob == 2022, co2_yob_eft_2022,
      yob == 2023, co2_yob_eft_2023
    )]
    new_fet[, co2_dp_eft := fcase(
      dam_parity == 1, fco2_dp_eft_1,
      dam_parity > 1, fco2_dp_eft_2
    )]
    new_fet[, co2_ls_eft := fcase(
      litter_size == 1, fco2_ls_eft_1,
      litter_size == 2, fco2_ls_eft_2,
      litter_size == 3, fco2_ls_eft_3,
      litter_size == 4, fco2_ls_eft_4
    )]
    
    
    # Fixed effect yield methane
    ych4_yob_eft_2018 <- rnorm(1, 0, 1.6)
    ych4_yob_eft_2019 <- rnorm(1, 0, 1.6)
    ych4_yob_eft_2020 <- rnorm(1, 0, 1.6)
    ych4_yob_eft_2021 <- rnorm(1, 0, 1.6)
    ych4_yob_eft_2022 <- rnorm(1, 0, 1.6)
    ych4_yob_eft_2023 <- rnorm(1, 0, 1.6)
    new_fet[, ych4_sex_eft := ifelse(
      sex == "F", fych4_sex_eft_f, fych4_sex_eft_m
    )]
    new_fet[, ych4_yob_eft := fcase(
      yob == 2018, ych4_yob_eft_2018,
      yob == 2019, ych4_yob_eft_2019,
      yob == 2020, ych4_yob_eft_2020,
      yob == 2021, ych4_yob_eft_2021,
      yob == 2022, ych4_yob_eft_2022,
      yob == 2023, ych4_yob_eft_2023
    )]
    new_fet[, ych4_dp_eft := fcase(
      dam_parity == 1, fych4_dp_eft_1,
      dam_parity > 1, fych4_dp_eft_2
    )]
    new_fet[, ych4_ls_eft := fcase(
      litter_size == 1, fych4_ls_eft_1,
      litter_size == 2, fych4_ls_eft_2,
      litter_size == 3, fych4_ls_eft_3,
      litter_size == 4, fych4_ls_eft_4
    )]  
    
    
    # Fixed effect yield carbon dioxide
    yco2_yob_eft_2018 <- rnorm(1, 0, 70)
    yco2_yob_eft_2019 <- rnorm(1, 0, 70)
    yco2_yob_eft_2020 <- rnorm(1, 0, 70)
    yco2_yob_eft_2021 <- rnorm(1, 0, 70)
    yco2_yob_eft_2022 <- rnorm(1, 0, 70)
    yco2_yob_eft_2023 <- rnorm(1, 0, 70)
    new_fet[, yco2_sex_eft := ifelse(
      sex == "F", fyco2_sex_eft_f, fyco2_sex_eft_m
    )]
    new_fet[, yco2_yob_eft := fcase(
      yob == 2018, yco2_yob_eft_2018,
      yob == 2019, yco2_yob_eft_2019,
      yob == 2020, yco2_yob_eft_2020,
      yob == 2021, yco2_yob_eft_2021,
      yob == 2022, yco2_yob_eft_2022,
      yob == 2023, yco2_yob_eft_2023
    )]
    new_fet[, yco2_dp_eft := fcase(
      dam_parity == 1, fyco2_dp_eft_1,
      dam_parity > 1, fyco2_dp_eft_2
    )]
    new_fet[, yco2_ls_eft := fcase(
      litter_size == 1, fyco2_ls_eft_1,
      litter_size == 2, fyco2_ls_eft_2,
      litter_size == 3, fyco2_ls_eft_3,
      litter_size == 4, fyco2_ls_eft_4
    )]
    
       ##############################################
    ## ---- Mendelian sampling (TBVs): 2y-driven conditioning ----
    ## traitNames.1d: c("bw","fi","ch4","co2")
    ## traitNames.2y: c("bw","fi","ych4","yco2")
    
    # Indices (common / remainders)
    c_idx    <- c(1, 2)   # bw, fi
    r_idx_2y <- c(3, 4)   # ych4, yco2 (in 2y)
    r_idx_1d <- c(3, 4)   # ch4,  co2  (in 1d)
    
    # Genetic blocks (G matrices passed in as fg.sigma.*)
    g_Scc_2y <- fg.sigma.2y[c_idx, c_idx, drop = FALSE]
    g_Src_2y <- fg.sigma.2y[r_idx_2y, c_idx, drop = FALSE]
    g_Srr_2y <- fg.sigma.2y[r_idx_2y, r_idx_2y, drop = FALSE]
    
    g_Scc_1d <- fg.sigma.1d[c_idx, c_idx, drop = FALSE]
    g_Src_1d <- fg.sigma.1d[r_idx_1d, c_idx, drop = FALSE]
    g_Srr_1d <- fg.sigma.1d[r_idx_1d, r_idx_1d, drop = FALSE]
    
    # 1) Draw common (bw, fi) for MS from 2y genetics (mean 0 for MS)
    Cg0 <- MASS::mvrnorm(n = offsp_num, mu = c(0, 0), Sigma = g_Scc_2y)
    
    # 2) Conditionals for remainders (mean 0 for MS):
    g_Scc_inv_2y <- solve(g_Scc_2y)
    g_Scc_inv_1d <- solve(g_Scc_1d)
    
    # 2y remainder: (ych4, yco2) | (bw, fi)
    g_cond_mean_2y <- t(g_Src_2y %*% g_Scc_inv_2y %*% t(Cg0))             # n x 2
    g_cond_cov_2y  <- g_Srr_2y - g_Src_2y %*% g_Scc_inv_2y %*% t(g_Src_2y)
    Rg0_2y         <- g_cond_mean_2y + MASS::mvrnorm(offsp_num, c(0,0), g_cond_cov_2y)
    
    # 1d remainder: (ch4, co2) | (bw, fi)
    g_cond_mean_1d <- t(g_Src_1d %*% g_Scc_inv_1d %*% t(Cg0))             # n x 2
    g_cond_cov_1d  <- g_Srr_1d - g_Src_1d %*% g_Scc_inv_1d %*% t(g_Src_1d)
    Rg0_1d         <- g_cond_mean_1d + MASS::mvrnorm(offsp_num, c(0,0), g_cond_cov_1d)
    
    # 3) Scale so Var(MS) = 0.5 * G (as in your original code)
    rt2 <- sqrt(0.5)
    MS_os <- data.table::data.table(
      MS.bw_tbv   = Cg0[, 1]     * rt2,  # same bw across systems
      MS.fi_tbv   = Cg0[, 2]     * rt2,  # same fi across systems
      MS.ch4_tbv  = Rg0_1d[, 1]  * rt2,  # from 1d conditional
      MS.co2_tbv  = Rg0_1d[, 2]  * rt2,  # from 1d conditional
      MS.ych4_tbv = Rg0_2y[, 1]  * rt2,  # from 2y conditional
      MS.yco2_tbv = Rg0_2y[, 2]  * rt2   # from 2y conditional
    )
    
    ## ---- Parents → Offspring TBVs + MS (your existing logic) ----
    sire_tbvs <- prev_gen[, c("id", paste0(traitNames, ".tbv")), with = FALSE]
    data.table::setnames(sire_tbvs, c("id", paste0("sire_", traitNames, "_tbv")))
    dam_tbvs <- data.table::copy(sire_tbvs)
    data.table::setnames(dam_tbvs, old = names(dam_tbvs),
                         new = c("id", paste0("dam_", traitNames, "_tbv")))
    
    TBV_data <- merge(new_ped, sire_tbvs, by.x = "sire", by.y = "id", all.x = TRUE)
    TBV_data <- merge(TBV_data, dam_tbvs,  by.x = "dam",  by.y = "id", all.x = TRUE)
    TBV_data <- cbind(TBV_data, MS_os)
    
    for (trait in traitNames) {
      tbv_col  <- paste0(trait, ".tbv")
      sire_col <- paste0("sire_", trait, "_tbv")
      dam_col  <- paste0("dam_",  trait, "_tbv")
      ms_col   <- paste0("MS.",    trait, "_tbv")
      TBV_data[, (tbv_col) := 0.5 * get(sire_col) + 0.5 * get(dam_col) + get(ms_col)]
    }
    
    drop_cols <- c(grep("sire_|dam_|^MS\\.", names(TBV_data), value = TRUE), "sire", "dam")
    TBV_data[, (drop_cols) := NULL]
    data.table::setorder(TBV_data, id)
    TBV_data[, id := NULL]
    
    ##############################################
    ## ---- Environment: 2y-driven conditioning ----
    
    # Env blocks (E matrices)
    e_Scc_2y <- fe.cov_matrix.2y[c_idx, c_idx, drop = FALSE]
    e_Src_2y <- fe.cov_matrix.2y[r_idx_2y, c_idx, drop = FALSE]
    e_Srr_2y <- fe.cov_matrix.2y[r_idx_2y, r_idx_2y, drop = FALSE]
    
    e_Scc_1d <- fe.cov_matrix.1d[c_idx, c_idx, drop = FALSE]
    e_Src_1d <- fe.cov_matrix.1d[r_idx_1d, c_idx, drop = FALSE]
    e_Srr_1d <- fe.cov_matrix.1d[r_idx_1d, r_idx_1d, drop = FALSE]
    
    # Means
    e_mu_c_2y <- fe.Mean.2y[c_idx]
    e_mu_r_2y <- fe.Mean.2y[r_idx_2y]
    e_mu_c_1d <- fe.Mean.1d[c_idx]
    e_mu_r_1d <- fe.Mean.1d[r_idx_1d]
    
    # 1) Common (bw, fi) from 2y env
    Ce <- MASS::mvrnorm(n = offsp_num, mu = e_mu_c_2y, Sigma = e_Scc_2y)
    
    # 2) Conditionals for remainders
    e_Scc_inv_2y <- solve(e_Scc_2y)
    e_Scc_inv_1d <- solve(e_Scc_1d)
    
    # 2y remainder: (ych4, yco2) | (bw, fi)
    dev2y <- sweep(Ce, 2, e_mu_c_2y, "-")
    e_cond_mean_2y <- t(e_Src_2y %*% e_Scc_inv_2y %*% t(dev2y)) +
                      matrix(rep(e_mu_r_2y, each = offsp_num), ncol = 2, byrow = FALSE)
    e_cond_cov_2y  <- e_Srr_2y - e_Src_2y %*% e_Scc_inv_2y %*% t(e_Src_2y)
    Re_2y          <- e_cond_mean_2y + MASS::mvrnorm(offsp_num, c(0,0), e_cond_cov_2y)
    
    # 1d remainder: (ch4, co2) | (bw, fi)
    dev1d <- sweep(Ce, 2, e_mu_c_1d, "-")
    e_cond_mean_1d <- t(e_Src_1d %*% e_Scc_inv_1d %*% t(dev1d)) +
                      matrix(rep(e_mu_r_1d, each = offsp_num), ncol = 2, byrow = FALSE)
    e_cond_cov_1d  <- e_Srr_1d - e_Src_1d %*% e_Scc_inv_1d %*% t(e_Src_1d)
    Re_1d          <- e_cond_mean_1d + MASS::mvrnorm(offsp_num, c(0,0), e_cond_cov_1d)
    
    # Assemble env DT (shared bw.env & fi.env; 1d CH4/CO2; 2y yCH4/yCO2)
    gn_env <- data.table::data.table(
      bw.env   = Ce[, 1],
      fi.env   = Ce[, 2],
      ch4.env  = Re_1d[, 1],
      co2.env  = Re_1d[, 2],
      ych4.env = Re_2y[, 1],
      yco2.env = Re_2y[, 2]
    )
    ##############################################
    
    ## ---- Assemble and continue (unchanged) ----
    new_gen <- cbind(new_ped, new_fet, TBV_data, gn_env)
    
    new_gen[, bw.p   := rowSums(.SD, na.rm = TRUE),           .SDcols = patterns("^bw")]
    new_gen[, fi.p   := pmax(0.05, rowSums(.SD, na.rm = TRUE)), .SDcols = patterns("^fi")]
    if (gas_fe_rule == "as_run") {
      # as run for the published datasets: no fixed effects on the gas traits
      # (the fixed effects above are still drawn so the random number stream is unchanged)
      new_gen[, ch4.p  := ch4.tbv + ch4.env]
      new_gen[, co2.p  := co2.tbv + co2.env]
      new_gen[, ych4.p := pmax(5, ych4.tbv + ych4.env)]
      new_gen[, yco2.p := yco2.tbv + yco2.env]
    } else {
      new_gen[, ch4.p  := rowSums(.SD, na.rm = TRUE),           .SDcols = patterns("^ch4")]
      new_gen[, co2.p  := rowSums(.SD, na.rm = TRUE),           .SDcols = patterns("^co2")]
      new_gen[, ych4.p := pmax(5, rowSums(.SD, na.rm = TRUE)),    .SDcols = patterns("^ych4")]
      new_gen[, yco2.p := rowSums(.SD, na.rm = TRUE),           .SDcols = patterns("^yco2")]
    }
    
    top_sires <- new_gen[sex == "M"][order(-bw.p)][1:fselect_sires_num]
    females   <- new_gen[sex == "F"]
    new_gen_filtered <- data.table::setorder(rbind(top_sires, females), id)
    
    new_gen_cond <- data.table::copy(new_gen_filtered)
    new_gen_cond[, grep("eft$", names(new_gen_cond), value = TRUE) := NULL]
    new_gen_cond[, grep("env$", names(new_gen_cond), value = TRUE) := NULL]
    new_gen_cond[, ch4.p.x := ych4.p * fi.p]
    new_gen_cond[, co2.p.x := yco2.p * fi.p]
    
    prev_gen <- rbind(prev_gen, new_gen_cond)

    ##############################################

  }
  
  return(prev_gen)
}
```

```{r}
e.cov_matrix.1d <- as.matrix(e.sigma.1d)


# the e.cor correlation matrix is calculated using h2, g.cor, and p.cor
e.cor.2y <- numeric(length(p.cor.2y)) 
idx <- 1
for (i in 2:length(traitNames.2y)) {
  for (j in 1:(i - 1)) {
    h_i.2y <- (h2.2y[i])
    h_j.2y <- (h2.2y[j])
    
    # e.cor equation (working in notebook and Peter's email)
    denom.2y <- sqrt((1 - h2.2y[i])) * sqrt((1 - h2.2y[j]))
    e.cor.2y[idx] <- (p.cor.2y[idx] - sqrt(h_i.2y) * sqrt(h_j.2y) * g.cor.2y[idx]) / denom.2y
    idx <- idx + 1
  }
}


e.Mean.2y <- c(0, 0, 0, 0)
e.sd.2y <- sqrt(p.Variance.2y * (1 - h2.2y))
e.Variance.2y <- e.sd.2y^2

# Correlation matrix
e.rho.2y <- diag(length(traitNames.2y))
e.rho.2y[upper.tri(e.rho.2y)] <- e.cor.2y
low.tri <- lower.tri(e.rho.2y)
e.rho.2y[low.tri.2y] <- t(e.rho.2y)[low.tri.2y]
# Make correlation matrix positive definite.
e.rho.2y <- corpcor::make.positive.definite(e.rho.2y)
# Covariance matrix of correlated traits.
e.sigma.2y <- sqrt(e.Variance.2y %*% t(e.Variance.2y)) * e.rho.2y
e.sigma.2y <- corpcor::make.positive.definite(e.sigma.2y)
e.cov_matrix.2y <- as.matrix(e.sigma.2y)
```

# Masking 50% gas sim

```{r}
set.seed(123)  # optional for reproducibility

# Get your original 60 data frames into a list
full_sims <- mget(paste0("full_sim_", 1:60))

# Create modified copies
full_sims_missing <- lapply(full_sims, function(df) {
  flip <- runif(nrow(df)) < 0.5
  df[flip, c("ch4.p.x", "co2.p.x")] <- NA
  df
})

# Assign them back as full_sim_61 … full_sim_120
names(full_sims_missing) <- paste0("full_sim_", 61:120)
list2env(full_sims_missing, .GlobalEnv)
```

# Masking 70% gas sim

```{r}
set.seed(90)  # reproducible

# Pull originals 1..60 into a list
full_sims <- mget(paste0("full_sim_", 61:120))

# Create modified copies with 40% missing on eligible rows
full_sims_missing70 <- lapply(full_sims, function(df) {
  # eligible rows: both present
  eligible <- !is.na(df$ch4.p.x) & !is.na(df$co2.p.x)
  # 40% selection among all rows, but only applied where eligible
  pick <- (runif(nrow(df)) < 0.40) & eligible
  df[pick, c("ch4.p.x", "co2.p.x")] <- NA
  df
})

# Assign as full_sim_121 .. full_sim_180
# Combines all simulations into one list
names(full_sims_missing70) <- paste0("full_sim_", 121:180)
list2env(full_sims_missing70, .GlobalEnv)
```



# Residual traits

There are three models and these will be called 
- res_1 - adjust daily methane for live weight
- res_2 - adjust daily methane for daily carbon dioxide
- res_3 - adjust daily methane for live weight and daily carbon dioxide 

```{r}
# res 1
for (i in 1:180) {
  df_name <- paste0("full_sim_", i)
  df <- get(df_name)

  fit <- lm(
    ch4.p.x ~ bw.p + factor(yob) + factor(sex) + factor(litter_size) + factor(dam_parity),
    data = df,
    na.action = na.exclude
  )
  
  df$res_1 <- resid(fit)
  assign(df_name, df, envir = .GlobalEnv)
}

```

```{r}
# res 2
for (i in 1:180) {
  df_name <- paste0("full_sim_", i)
  df <- get(df_name)

  fit2 <- lm(
    ch4.p.x ~ co2.p.x + factor(yob) + factor(sex) + factor(litter_size) + factor(dam_parity),
    data = df,
    na.action = na.exclude
  )

  df$res_2 <- resid(fit2)
  assign(df_name, df, envir = .GlobalEnv)
}
```

```{r}
# res 3

  df_name <- paste0("full_sim_", i)
  df <- get(df_name)

  fit3 <- lm(
    ch4.p.x ~ bw.p + co2.p.x +
      factor(yob) + factor(sex) + factor(litter_size) + factor(dam_parity),
    data = df,
    na.action = na.exclude
  )

  df$res_3 <- resid(fit3)
  assign(df_name, df, envir = .GlobalEnv)
}
```

# Saving Datasets

Specify the directory where the generated datasets should be saved by changing save_directory to the desired location on your computer.

The full simulated populations are exported as .csv files for subsequent ASReml analysis. A dummy variable, with a value of 1 for all animals, is added as the final column of each full simulation dataset before export.

This section creates:

180 full simulation datasets (full_sim_1.csv to full_sim_180.csv)
180 pedigree datasets (all_ped_1.csv to all_ped_180.csv)

```{r, eval=FALSE}
# Set the folder where you want the datasets to be saved
save_directory <- "C:/Users/YourName/Documents/simulation_outputs"

# creating full sim data sets in .csv format
# This includes a "dummy" variable column of all 1s
for (i in 1:180) {
  filename <- file.path(save_directory, paste0("full_sim_", i, ".csv"))
  data <- get(paste0("full_sim_", i))
  data[, dummy := 1]  # add dummy column with value 1
  fwrite(data, filename)
}

# createing pedigree data sets in .csv format
# Format is tidy or this wouldn't be how pedigrees are created
# This is if the simulations are in the environment already  

for (i in 1:180) {
  filename <- file.path(save_directory, paste0("all_ped_", i, ".csv"))
  data <- get(paste0("full_sim_", i))[, 1:3, with = FALSE]  # select first 3 columns
  fwrite(data, filename)
}
```
